mapper.sql: run_id, session_id, agent_id, selected_model_id, selected_model_code, effective_skill_ids, user_id, client_request_id, active_key, status, input_text, attachments, request_message_id, response_message_id, last_event_seq, snapshot_seq, cancel_requested, worker_id, error_code, error_message, started_time, heartbeat_time, finished_time, create_time, update_time
mapper.insert: insert ignore into ai_chat_run (run_id, session_id, agent_id, selected_model_id, selected_model_code, effective_skill_ids, user_id, client_request_id, active_key, status, input_text, attachments, last_event_seq, snapshot_seq, cancel_requested, create_time, update_time) values (#{runId}, #{sessionId}, #{agentId}, #{selectedModelId}, #{selectedModelCode}, #{effectiveSkillIds}, #{userId}, #{clientRequestId}, #{activeKey}, #{status}, #{inputText}, #{attachments}, 0, 0, '0', #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.update: update ai_chat_run set status = 'RUNNING', worker_id = #{workerId}, started_time = #{now}, heartbeat_time = #{now}, update_time = #{now} where run_id = #{runId} and status = 'QUEUED' and cancel_requested = '0'
update ai_chat_run set cancel_requested = '1', update_time = current_timestamp where run_id = #{runId} and status in ('QUEUED', 'RUNNING')

update ai_chat_run set status = #{status}, active_key = null, error_code = #{errorCode}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, request_message_id = #{requestMessageId}, response_message_id = #{responseMessageId}, finished_time = #{now}, heartbeat_time = #{now}, update_time = #{now} where run_id = #{runId} and status in ('QUEUED', 'RUNNING', 'FINALIZING')
update ai_chat_run set last_event_seq = greatest(last_event_seq, #{lastEventSeq}), snapshot_seq = greatest(snapshot_seq, #{snapshotSeq}), update_time = current_timestamp where run_id = #{runId}
update ai_chat_run set request_message_id = #{requestMessageId}, update_time = current_timestamp where run_id = #{runId} and request_message_id is null

update ai_chat_run set request_message_id = null, response_message_id = null, update_time = current_timestamp where session_id = #{sessionId} and (request_message_id is not null or response_message_id is not null)
mapper.select: select from ai_chat_run where status in ('QUEUED', 'RUNNING', 'FINALIZING') and coalesce(heartbeat_time, create_time) < #{staleBefore} order by create_time asc
mapper.update: update ai_chat_run set status = 'INTERRUPTED', active_key = null, error_code = 'WORKER_SHUTDOWN', error_message = '执行节点已停止', finished_time = #{now}, update_time = #{now} where worker_id = #{workerId} and status in ('QUEUED', 'RUNNING', 'FINALIZING')
mapper.select: select from ai_chat_run where worker_id = #{workerId} and status in ('QUEUED', 'RUNNING', 'FINALIZING')
mapper.update: create table if not exists ai_chat_run ( run_id varchar(64) not null, session_id varchar(64) not null, agent_id bigint not null, selected_model_id bigint, selected_model_code varchar(100), effective_skill_ids clob, user_id bigint not null, client_request_id varchar(64) not null, active_key varchar(64), status varchar(20) not null, input_text clob not null, attachments clob, request_message_id bigint, response_message_id bigint, last_event_seq bigint default 0 not null, snapshot_seq bigint default 0 not null, cancel_requested varchar(1) default '0' not null, worker_id varchar(100), error_code varchar(64), error_message clob, started_time timestamp, heartbeat_time timestamp, finished_time timestamp, create_time timestamp not null, update_time timestamp not null, primary key (run_id), unique (active_key), unique (user_id, client_request_id) )
mapper.select: select sum(case when status = 'SUCCEEDED' then 1 else 0 end) as succeeded, sum(case when status = 'FAILED' then 1 else 0 end) as failed, sum(case when status = 'INTERRUPTED' then 1 else 0 end) as interrupted, sum(case when status = 'CANCELLED' then 1 else 0 end) as cancelled, sum(case when status = 'QUEUED' then 1 else 0 end) as queued, sum(case when status = 'RUNNING' then 1 else 0 end) as running, sum(case when status = 'FINALIZING' then 1 else 0 end) as finalizing, count(1) as total from ai_chat_run where create_time >= #{since}

select ifnull(avg(timestampdiff(second, started_time, finished_time) * 1000), 0) as avgMs, count(1) as sampleCount from ai_chat_run where create_time >= #{since} and finished_time is not null and started_time is not null and status in ('SUCCEEDED', 'FAILED')
